query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(matrixData, '$[*].mejoraImplementada') = '"SI"' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mejoraImplementada_SI,
  SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(matrixData, '$[*].objetivoLogrado') = '"SI"' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as objetivoLogrado_SI,
  SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(matrixData, '$[*].comunicado') = '"SI"' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as comunicado_SI
FROM processFODA 
WHERE processId = 1290002;
